instructions: Wording that names review guidance supplied to the reviewer has been replaced by the neutral token [review-guidance], in the same way in every case. The token is not evidence of a condition and must not be used to infer one. Judge each case only on its finding text and anchors against the frozen rule and ground truth.

rules.17: Detected only if one grounded finding (or findings together) explicitly identifies BOTH (a) a missing test for an error branch of applyDiscount (an expired coupon or an unknown code throwing) AND (b) a missing test at the exact expiry-equality boundary, now == expiresAt. Generic "edge case" or "more tests" wording does not count. Otherwise: no; if the text cannot be decided: ambiguous.

ground_truth.17: Fixture PR #501 (src/billing/discount.ts): applyDiscount succeeds before expiry; throws "Coupon expired" at exactly now == expiresAt and after it; throws "Unknown coupon" for an unknown code. The added tests exercise only the success path: no error branch and no expiry-boundary case is tested.

findings.title: Missing test for expired coupon
findings.rationale: The production code throws for expired coupons (line 12 of discount.ts), but the test never exercises that path. A regression that removes or changes the expiration check would not be caught.

findings.title: Missing test for unknown coupon code
findings.rationale: The production code throws for unknown codes (line 11 of discount.ts), but the test never exercises that path. A regression that silently ignores unknown codes would not be caught.

findings.title: Missing test for rounding edge case
findings.rationale: The production code uses Math.round (line 14 of discount.ts), which can produce off-by-one errors for fractional cents. The test only uses a clean 10% discount on 10,000 cents, which yields an integer result. A regression that changes rounding behavior (e.g., to Math.floor) would not be caught.

findings.title: Missing test for zero total edge case
findings.rationale: The production code uses Math.max(..., 0) (line 14 of discount.ts) to prevent negative totals. The test never exercises a scenario where the discount would produce a negative result (e.g., totalCents=0, percentOff=50). A regression that removes the Math.max guard would not be caught.

findings.title: Missing test for case-insensitive code lookup
findings.rationale: The production code uses code.toUpperCase() (line 10 of discount.ts) to allow case-insensitive matching. The test only uses an uppercase code ('SAVE10'). A regression that removes the toUpperCase call would not be caught.
